claim_under_attack: A CAN BE CLOSED BY DEFINING S AS ALL INTERFACE_ADMISSIBLE CAUSAL TRANSDUCERS AND PROVING ONE FIXED BRAIN POLICY DOMINATES EVERY MEMBER OF S WITHOUT TARGET STRUCTURAL RESTRICTION.
theorem: FOR_ANY_FIXED_BRAIN POLICY THAT DOES NOT RANDOMIZE WITH FULL MASS ON EVERY MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE OPTIMAL ACTION, AN UNRESTRICTED TARGET CLASS CAN CONTAIN A POLICY THAT PLACES MORE MASS ON AN ACTION PREFERRED BY SOME ADMISSIBLE LOAD_BEARING TERMINAL UTILITY.
THEREFORE UNIVERSAL BRAIN_DOMINANCE OVER THE CLASS OF ALL INTERFACE_ADMISSIBLE TARGET TRANSDUCERS IS NOT A SOUND GENERIC CLOSURE ROUTE.
MAKING THE TARGET SUPERDOMAIN EXTENSIONALLY BROADER CAN MAKE COVERAGE TRIVIAL WHILE MAKING DOMINANCE IMPOSSIBLY STRONG.

A SOUND A/L1 ROUTE MUST INCLUDE TARGET_STRUCTURAL RESTRICTIONS, COMPLETE TARGET SPECIFICATION, A FINITE EXHAUSTED DOMAIN, OR SOME EQUIVALENT INFORMATION THAT EXCLUDES TERMINALLY DISTINCT ADVERSARIAL TARGETS.

distinction.interface_coverage: AN EXTERNAL INTERACTION ALPHABET CAN CONTAIN ALL OPUS55 BEHAVIOR WITHOUT IDENTIFYING WHICH BEHAVIORAL LAWS OPUS55 ACTUALLY REALIZES.
distinction.target_structure: A STRUCTURAL HYPOTHESIS CLASS RESTRICTS THE TERMINALLY RELEVANT TARGET LAWS ENOUGH THAT EVIDENCE CAN IDENTIFY OR ROBUSTLY DOMINATE THE REMAINING CLASS.
distinction.consequence: INTERFACE COVERAGE ALONE IS NOT STRUCTURAL IDENTIFIABILITY.

scheduler_repair: DELETE UNRESTRICTED_ALL_TRANSDUCERS_DOMINANCE AS AN A CLOSURE STRATEGY.
PRESERVE FIXED_INTERFACE SUPERDOMAINS ONLY AS CONTAINERS FOR TARGET STRUCTURAL CLASSES OR AS COVERAGE PREMISES.
SEARCH FOR THE SMALLEST SOUND TARGET_STRUCTURAL CLASS THAT CONTAINS THE ACTUAL FROZEN OPUS55 TARGET AND QUOTIENT IT BY TERMINAL RELEVANCE.
USE FINITE TARGET OBSERVATIONS ONLY WHEN THEY SHRINK THAT STRUCTURAL CLASS OR EXHAUST A PROVED FINITE DOMAIN.
IF NO SUCH STRUCTURAL CLASS CAN BE PROVED FROM CURRENT EVIDENCE, RECORD THE REMAINING TARGET INFORMATION AS IRREDUCIBLE RATHER THAN RUNNING UNBOUNDED BENCHMARKS.
